definitions.explanation: Having qualities that arouse interest, admiration, or desire.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はとても{魅力的|みりょくてき}な{人|ひと}です。
examples.english: She is a very attractive person.

examples.japanese: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{条件|じょうけん}を{提示|ていじ}されました。
examples.english: I was presented with attractive conditions.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}の{魅力的|みりょくてき}なところは{何|なん}ですか？

notes:
{魅力的|みりょくてき} is a na-adjective meaning attractive or charming, derived from {魅力|みりょく} (charm, appeal).

FORMS:
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}な + noun: attractive ~
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}に: attractively

CAN DESCRIBE:
- People: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{人|ひと} (attractive person)
- Offers: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{条件|じょうけん} (attractive terms)
- Places: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{街|まち} (charming town)
- Ideas: {魅力的|みりょくてき}な{提案|ていあん} (appealing proposal)

COMPARISON:
- {魅力的|みりょくてき}: attractive/charming (formal, versatile)
- かわいい: cute (casual, appearance-focused)
- かっこいい: cool/handsome (casual, appearance-focused)
- {美|うつく}しい: beautiful (formal, aesthetic)

RELATED:
{魅力|みりょく}: charm, appeal (noun)
